- flickr_add_discussion_topic_to_group: Flickr - almost certainly the best online photo management and sharing application in the world.. Post a new discussion topic to a group. Performance Advisory: This endpoint assumes upstream sentiment

This confirms the target product is available, but we need the specific review comments before drafting responses. I will proceed to fetch the individual reviews from the provided URL.
